captions.detailed: A rectangular, box-shaped industrial air purifier with a light gray main body. The top surface features a long, black rectangular exhaust grille with a perforated grid. The front face is divided into two side-by-side filter bays, each enclosed by a hinged gray door. Both doors have vertical black handles and are mounted on revolute hinges, allowing them to swing open outward from the central frame.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a dual-bay air purifier unit. It should feature a wide, light gray rectangular housing with a black perforated top vent, and two front compartment doors that swing open via revolute joints, each equipped with a vertical black handle.
captions.factory: The model is built using a main body box with a top-mounted thin box representing the black vent grille. Two separate door assemblies are constructed, each consisting of a flat rectangular panel, a thin vertical cylinder for the handle, and hinge pins. These doors are then attached to the main body using revolute articulations positioned on the left and right front edges of the frame.
